fonts.display: 'ITC Garamond Std Light Narrow', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Graphik Medium', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cobalt Signal
palette.role: Violet action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on cobalt fill, heading text on dark sections

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Primary body text, heading text, hairline borders, icon strokes — the workhorse near-black that carries UI structure

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Deepest text, dark gradient anchor points, near-black accents where maximum contrast is needed

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Absolute black for borders, icons, and the film-strip frame effect — appears most in structural borders rather than type

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Soft card surface lift, input fields, subtle background differentiation from pure white canvas

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Light surface wash, disabled or decorative backgrounds

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Muted body copy, secondary borders, placeholder text — the dominant mid-gray carrying prose-level hierarchy
